sources.detail: Path B 11-for-11 swap: +5 tutors, +1 fast mana, +2 ramp, +3 T2-T3 creature-token enablers, +2 spot removal upgrades; -7 slow engine cards, -2 redundant wipes/doubler, -2 opponent-buff removal.

guideContent.strategyOverview: Bant token engine that exploits Donatello's replacement effect — every token you create also produces a Mutagen artifact. Leonardo puts +1/+1 counters on each creature whenever a token enters, building a wide and tall board simultaneously. Token doublers like Parallel Lives and Anointed Procession multiply both the original tokens AND the bonus Mutagens exponentially. Academy Manufactor converts any Food, Clue, or Treasure into all three types, each triggering Donatello for additional Mutagens. The deck finishes games through Cyberdrive Awakener (turning Mutagen artifacts into 4/4 flyers), Herald of Secret Streams (making all countered creatures unblockable), or Cyclonic Rift into an alpha strike with the token army.

winConditions.title: Cyclonic Rift Alpha Strike
winConditions.description: Overload Cyclonic Rift at instant speed to bounce all opponents' nonland permanents. Swing with the token army that has been accumulating +1/+1 counters from Leonardo's triggers. The cleanest finisher — one-sided board clear into lethal combat.

winConditions.title: Cyberdrive Awakener
winConditions.description: Cast Cyberdrive Awakener to turn all noncreature artifacts into 4/4 flying creatures until end of turn. With 10+ Mutagen tokens from Donatello's triggers, this represents 40+ flying damage. Must attack the same turn — no haste needed since the artifacts become creatures on your turn.

winConditions.title: Herald Unblockable Army
winConditions.description: Herald of Secret Streams makes all creatures with +1/+1 counters unblockable. Leonardo's trigger puts counters on every creature whenever a token enters. With a board of 5+ creatures, each carrying multiple counters, the unblockable army deals lethal in one swing.

winConditions.title: Infinite Token Loop
winConditions.description: Basking Broodscale, Scurry Oak, or Herd Baloth each go infinite with either Rosie Cotton or Cathars' Crusade. A token enters → triggers +1/+1 counter → creature creates another token → repeat infinitely. Basking Broodscale also generates infinite mana via its adapt-like ability. Any of these loops produces infinite tokens and infinite +1/+1 counters for a lethal attack.

sources.detail: Basking Broodscale + Rosie Cotton (and 5 related combos)

winConditions.title: Second Harvest Burst
winConditions.description: Cast Second Harvest at instant speed to create a copy of each token you control. Every new token triggers Leonardo for +1/+1 counters and Donatello for bonus Mutagens. With 10 tokens on board, this doubles to 20+ and triggers a cascade of counter placement across all creatures.

winConditions.title: Counter Avalanche
winConditions.description: Doubling Season doubles both tokens and counters. Cathars' Crusade adds +1/+1 counters for each creature ETB with no once-per-turn limit. Combined with Leonardo's triggers and token generation, a single Avenger of Zendikar creates 14+ Plant tokens, each triggering 3+ counter placements doubled by Doubling Season, resulting in 20/20+ creatures.

synergies.title: Manufactor Assembly Line
synergies.description: Any Food, Clue, or Treasure creation becomes all three token types via Manufactor. Donatello adds a Mutagen to the batch. Result: 4 tokens from a single trigger. With a doubler: 8 tokens.

synergies.title: Passive Mutagen Factory
synergies.description: Each opponent's draw step creates a Treasure (unless they pay {2}). Donatello adds a Mutagen to each Treasure. Passive token generation that accelerates every turn cycle without spending mana.

synergies.title: Unlimited Counter Stacking
synergies.description: Cathars' Crusade has no once-per-turn limit — every creature ETB adds +1/+1 to all creatures. Combined with Leonardo's token-entry trigger, a burst of 5 creature tokens creates 5 Crusade triggers (25 total counters distributed) plus 5 Leonardo triggers. The board grows exponentially with each token wave.

synergies.title: Mutagen Air Force
synergies.description: Donatello accumulates Mutagen artifact tokens passively. Cyberdrive Awakener turns all noncreature artifacts into 4/4 flyers until end of turn. 10 Mutagens + other artifacts = 40+ flying damage in one swing.

synergies.title: Exponential Doublers
synergies.description: With Donatello, creating 1 token becomes 1 + 1 Mutagen. A single doubler makes that 2 + 2 Mutagens (4 total). Two doublers: 4 + 4 Mutagens (8 total). Each additional doubler multiplies the entire output.

synergies.title: Rosie Cotton Chain Reaction
synergies.description: Rosie puts a +1/+1 counter on another creature whenever any token is created. Leonardo puts counters on each creature when a token enters. Together, every single token creation event stacks multiple counters across the board.

synergies.title: Infinite Broodscale Engine
synergies.description: Basking Broodscale creates a 1/1 token whenever a +1/+1 counter is placed on it. Rosie Cotton or Cathars' Crusade places a counter on Broodscale when the token enters → creates another token → infinite loop. Unique among the combo creatures: Broodscale also generates infinite mana via its {G} adapt ability during the loop.

synergies.title: Infinite Token Creatures
synergies.description: Scurry Oak and Herd Baloth each create a token whenever a +1/+1 counter is placed on them. Pair with Rosie Cotton (counter on token creation) or Cathars' Crusade (counter on creature ETB) for an infinite loop. Scurry Oak makes 1/1 Squirrels; Herd Baloth makes 4/4 Beasts.

highlights.name: Voice of Victory
highlights.reason: 2 CMC creature that creates 2 Warrior tokens on attack via Mobilize 2, triggering Leonardo and Donatello. Opponents can't cast spells during your turn — protects combo turns and alpha strikes. Replaces Iridescent Hornbeetle: lower CMC, immediate impact, built-in protection.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Hornbeetle replacement — on-theme token generation + turn protection at 3 less CMC

highlights.name: Sylvan Library
highlights.reason: Elite card selection at 2 CMC. See 3 cards per turn to find doublers, combo pieces, and finishers faster. Replaces Ecologist's Terrarium — the weakest ramp piece in the deck.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Terrarium replacement — generically powerful card selection over mediocre ramp

highlights.name: Doubling Season
highlights.reason: Doubles both tokens AND counters. With Leonardo placing counters and Donatello creating Mutagen tokens, every trigger is amplified twice. The single highest-impact card for this strategy.

highlights.name: Parallel Lives
highlights.reason: Core token doubler. With Donatello: 1 token creation becomes 2 originals + 2 Mutagens. Stacks multiplicatively with Anointed Procession for 4x output.

highlights.name: Anointed Procession
highlights.reason: White Parallel Lives. Redundancy for the doubler strategy. Two doublers active = 4x token output from every creation event.

highlights.name: Smothering Tithe
highlights.reason: Game Changer #1. Creates Treasure tokens on every opponent's draw unless they pay {2}. In a 4-player game, generates 3+ Treasures per turn cycle. Each triggers Donatello for bonus Mutagens.

highlights.name: Aura Shards
highlights.reason: Game Changer #3. Destroys an artifact or enchantment whenever a creature enters. With token generation, this removes every problematic permanent opponents control.

highlights.name: Academy Manufactor
highlights.reason: Converts any Food, Clue, or Treasure creation into all three types. Each type triggers Donatello for a Mutagen. One token trigger becomes 4 tokens (8 with a doubler).

highlights.name: Cyberdrive Awakener
highlights.reason: Turns all noncreature artifacts into 4/4 flyers until end of turn. 10 Mutagen tokens = 40 flying damage. Must attack the same turn.

highlights.name: Cathars' Crusade
highlights.reason: No once-per-turn limit. Every creature ETB puts +1/+1 on all creatures. A burst of 5 tokens distributes 25 counters. Doubling Season doubles them to 50.

highlights.name: Avenger of Zendikar
highlights.reason: Creates Plant tokens equal to lands you control (7-10 typically). Each Plant triggers Leonardo's counters and Donatello's Mutagens. Landfall pumps all Plants. With doublers: 14-20+ tokens.

highlights.name: Herald of Secret Streams
highlights.reason: Creatures with +1/+1 counters can't be blocked. Leonardo puts counters on everything. The entire token army becomes unblockable.

highlights.name: Elspeth, Storm Slayer
highlights.reason: Token doubler on a planeswalker. Static ability doubles all token creation, stacking multiplicatively with Parallel Lives and Anointed Procession. Also creates Soldiers (+1), distributes +1/+1 counters with flying for alpha strikes (0), and removes threats (−3).

highlights.name: Hardened Scales
highlights.reason: At just {G}, adds +1 to every +1/+1 counter placement. Stacks with Michelangelo and Ozolith for triple amplification. Leonardo's base 1 counter per creature per token becomes 4 with all three active.

highlights.name: Basking Broodscale
highlights.reason: Goes infinite with Rosie Cotton or Cathars' Crusade — both already in the deck. Creates a 1/1 token whenever it gets a +1/+1 counter, and generates infinite mana via its adapt ability during the loop. The most versatile combo piece: infinite tokens, counters, AND mana.

highlights.name: Mondrak, Glory Dominus
highlights.reason: Token doubler on a 4/4 body. Can sacrifice 2 artifacts (Mutagens) to become indestructible. Doubles output while being resilient to removal.

highlights.name: Springheart Nantuko
highlights.reason: Landfall creates a 1/1 Insect token — triggers Leonardo's counters and Donatello's Mutagens on every land drop. Bestow mode copies the enchanted creature instead: put it on Avenger of Zendikar, Academy Manufactor, or any token doubler for exponential value. At {1}{G}, deploys turn 2 and starts generating value immediately.

highlights.name: Counterspell
highlights.reason: Unconditional 2-mana counterspell. Replaces Force of Will — at Bracket 3 speed, holding up {U}{U} is sufficient protection without the card disadvantage of pitching.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Force of Will moved to Creeping Corruption (B4 deck where free counterspells are mandatory)

highlights.name: Fierce Guardianship
highlights.reason: Free noncreature counterspell when Leonardo or Donatello is on the battlefield. Protects your token doublers and combo pieces without needing mana open.

sources.name: The Command Zone - Bracket 4 (Ep 731)
sources.detail: Listed as mandatory B4 blue free spell

highlights.name: Exalted Sunborn
highlights.reason: 7th token doubler on a 4/5 flying lifelink body. Doubles all token creation including Donatello's Mutagens. Warp {1}{W} enables a temporary doubler as early as turn 2 — no other doubler in the deck offers that tempo. Recastable from exile later for the permanent version. Replaces Tendershoot Dryad: explosive multiplication over incremental 1/turn drip.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: SOS review 01 — 7th doubler with unique Warp tempo, replacing weakest token generator

highlights.name: Pathbreaker Ibex
highlights.reason: Every-attack global Overrun: creatures you control gain trample and +X/+X where X is the greatest power on board. With Leonardo's counter spread + Cathars' Crusade stacking, X balloons to lethal range fast. A premier Bracket 4 finisher for a wide token board.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Bracket 4 token+combat finisher — replaces Hangarback Walker (slow X-cost grow) with a recurring Overrun.

highlights.name: Triumph of the Hordes
highlights.reason: Alpha-strike infect kill: +1/+1, trample, and infect for one turn. With Leonardo's counters and a wide token board, even small creatures convert to lethal poison damage across the table. Single-card win condition for the tokens+combat axis.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Bracket 4 finisher — converts a wide token board into a one-shot poison kill.

highlights.name: Vivien Reid
highlights.reason: Self-contained engine: +1 hand-fills with creatures/lands, -3 removes artifacts/enchantments/fliers, -8 emblem grants the team +2/+2 vigilance/trample/indestructible. Loyalty doubles with token-counter triggers. Owned, $0 spend.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Bracket 4 versatile planeswalker — card advantage + targeted removal + finisher emblem.

highlights.name: Tendershoot Dryad
highlights.reason: Recurring Saproling factory: every upkeep creates a 1/1 token, triggering Donatello (Mutagen per token-creation event) and Leonardo (counter spread). Once Ascend lands (city's blessing), Saprolings get +2/+2 static — stacking with the counter theme. Owned, $0 spend; replaces Mondrak's already-in-deck slot with a sustained token engine.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Substituted for Mondrak (already in deck) — recurring token engine fueling Donatello + Leonardo every upkeep.
